title: Distribute agricultural chemicals from the air only under licence
what: Carry out aerial distribution of agricultural chemicals only by a pilot holding a pilot chemical rating licence, in the course of the business of a licensed aerial distribution contractor.

sources.title: Agricultural Chemicals Distribution Control Act 1966 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person shall not carry out or cause or permit to be carried out aerial distribution unless the pilot in command of the aircraft from which the distribution is carried out holds a pilot chemical rating licence and the aerial distribution is carried out in the course of the business of, at the direction of or under the authority of a licensed aerial distribution contractor

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Agricultural Chemicals Distribution Control Act 1966 (Qld)

sources.title: Agricultural Chemicals Distribution Control Act 1966 (Qld)
